response:
```cypher
MATCH (a:Account)-[:HAS]->(:Site)-[:HOSTS]->(asset:Asset)<-[:SAME_AS]-(d:Drive)
WHERE d.failed = 1
  AND EXISTS {
    MATCH (c:Case)-[:ABOUT]->(asset)
    WHERE c.resolution_code IS NOT NULL
  }
RETURN a.name AS account_name, COUNT(DISTINCT d) AS failed_drive_count
ORDER BY failed_drive_count DESC, account_name
LIMIT 2
```
